plan: Doubles core for the Fire-heavy Magma/Lavaridge block. Mega Gyarados is the Mold Breaker Water/Dark win condition behind Togekiss Follow Me + Tailwind. Azumarill resists Fire and supplies Aqua Jet priority and Knock Off. Alakazam and Starmie supply recoil-free special coverage (Focus Blast for Rock/Steel, Ice Beam and Thunderbolt for the Flying/Ground reserves). Gallade is the Fighting/Psychic physical answer to Rhyperior and Coalossal.
